set.body:
Owns temporal-template-density-sampling. Delivered EpochPlan/EpochCodecs (bd-01KYDZ80ANFH3HW11946E4QTR8) provide selectors and final-bin policies; existing TemporalStudy implements windowed duration occupancy. Neither establishes sample_density_time parity.

Construct a distinct point-sampling workflow from eyesim-sampling's trajectory and finite-control contracts and eyesim-kde's normalization/nearest-grid lookup. It evaluates a STATIC template density at requested focal-path times. Do not use linear trajectory interpolation or duration-mass occupancy as an implicit replacement.

Acceptance cases: explicit query/fixation time units and clock agreement; before/at/between/after onsets; repeated/unsorted queries; all four normalizations; nearest-grid ties and outside coordinates; exactly-on-bin-boundary and exactly-last-boundary queries; missing/all-missing/empty bins with contributing and requested counts. Pin cut(right=FALSE, include.lowest=TRUE) at the final endpoint rather than assuming every bin is half-open. Reuse explicit epoch/final-bin policies only where they express the measured reference meaning; otherwise document typed divergence.

Pin matched-template identity, first duplicate/unmatched-row behavior, stratification, exclusion of ALL true-match copies, candidate multiplicity, requested/realized permutations and no eligible controls. Distinguish the reference's mean-over-controls at each time followed by bin aggregation from pooled control-time aggregation. Freeze supported aggregation as a typed named method/registration with schema and provenance; arbitrary R callbacks are not a persistable native API.

Exit: saved point-sampling plan/result, an independent step-trajectory over an asymmetric 2x2 map and exact bin/control accounting, locked R fixtures, portable tests and PARITY.md distinguishing this estimand from duration occupancy. No silent source/query loss. Full completion waits on eyesim-sampling and eyesim-kde; no need to reopen the closed epoch ticket.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Pin eyesim temporal density-sampling semantics
